effect.fr: Invoque Groudon à la Tour Enfouie.
effect.en: Summons Groudon to the Embedded Tower.

flavor.en: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend tied to it. It’s known to have a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
flavor.ko: 호연지방의 전설과 깊은 연관이 있다고 전해지는 빨갛게 빛나는 구슬.
flavor.ja: ホウエン地方の 伝説と 深い 関わりが あると いわれる あかく かがやく たま。
